No-Code AI Agent Builder

Noodle Seed helps software teams make their products ready for AI agents. Build workflows in TypeScript, expose them through a secure branded assistant inside your product, and make the same capabilities available to external agents. Instead of stitching together MCP SDKs and hosting infrastructure, Noodle Seed provides the governed runtime for identity, permissions, secrets, audit, and operations.
